purpose: Check whether each scale can be displayed as a pixel-level support/demo/audit mask and whether any scale may be promoted to real model inference.

per_scale.display_policy: Use coarse red pixels for regional support only; do not present as Dust-Mamba output.
May display red pixel-level support mask for screenshot and agent reasoning; must remain labelled not model inference.
Use high-resolution same-day Sentinel-2 layer for source/confounder support only; do not present as dust model inference.

promotion_blockers.reason: Round 030 keeps Dust-Mamba and LSDSSIMR audits active, but checkpoint files and LSDSSIMR HDF5 inputs are still not local; current red pixels are rendered AIRS Dust Score support, not model inference.
promotion_blockers.next_required_action: Download/verify Dust-Mamba checkpoint and a small LSDSSIMR/FY-4A event sample before the coarse mask can be model output.

promotion_blockers.reason: Current medium red pixels are same-sensor VIIRS support evidence, but no runnable VIIRS dust segmentation weights/code are connected.
promotion_blockers.next_required_action: Connect a VIIRS-specific dust semantic segmentation model or a documented sensor-specific algorithm before the medium red mask is promoted.

promotion_blockers.reason: Checkpoint and evaluation artifacts are local, but processed .npy inputs for the current AOI are missing.
promotion_blockers.next_required_action: Create or obtain a small processed MODIS input package and run actual inference before displaying MODIS model pixels as red dust anomalies.

promotion_blockers.reason: The Sentinel-2 COG audit now uses same-day S2A_46SEJ_20210315_2_L2A AOT/B04/B08/SCL data, but AOT is aerosol support and no Sentinel-2 dust/not-dust segmentation model was executed.
promotion_blockers.next_required_action: Connect a Sentinel-2-specific dust/confounder model before any high-resolution red mask is promoted to real dust inference.

fail_closed_policy: If a model output lacks same-sensor binding, current AOI/time evidence, schema fields, confidence/threshold, or confounder records, keep it as support/demo/research_reference and do not display it as real dust inference.
